title: Choose the look for MetricGuard
question: The roll assigned Chain of Custody. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Chain of Custody
options.lineage: forensic evidence handling: sealed bags, case numbers, tamper tape
options.thesis: Every result is sealed evidence with a case number you can replay.
options.viewport: Charcoal rail; the case header carries a perforated seal (case MG-0142, data hash, sealed time); the answer owns the top in one large figure; the record list below.
options.risk: Red seals can read as errors if state colours are not kept separate.

raised.raise: Every investigation and run gets a case number (MG-0142), used in search, links and headers.
Nothing disappears: superseded runs and drafts are stamped, never silently removed.
The answer owns the first viewport of every result: one sentence and one figure before anything else.
Each area keeps one committed hue on its tab, so where you are reads before any label.
Hierarchy by scale contrast: headline figures large, labels small mono, little in between.

options.label: Working Papers
options.lineage: audit working papers and tick-mark legends
options.thesis: Every verified figure carries an auditor's tick-mark and a reference.
options.viewport: Light shell with a left index; the result figure footed with green tick-marks; a legend explains each mark.
options.risk: The most familiar direction for finance tools; it may read conservative.

options.label: Graphite Console
options.thesis: A dense graphite workspace where panels persist and state takes the only colour.
options.viewport: Persistent panels: dataset and calculations on the left, the result and records on the right, all in one dark surface.
options.case: Holds product clarity (dense, task-first) but analysts identify less with it than with proof and evidence.
options.risk: Dark dense consoles are the predictable opposite of the category default.

options.label: Factory Catalog
options.thesis: Every artifact is a numbered catalog entry.
options.viewport: A black index of numbered entries.
options.case: Codes instead of names hurt clarity; analysts need labels.
options.kept: Strict catalog numbering: every investigation gets a case number.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.case: The journey metaphor does not match reconciliation work.
options.kept: States stamp onto records; nothing silently disappears.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.thesis: One item owns the whole screen.
options.viewport: One result per screen with a right rail.
options.case: Analysts compare and scan; one-at-a-time paging slows them.
options.kept: The answer owns the first viewport of a result.

options.label: Acetate Manual
options.thesis: Sections as coloured divider boards under acetate leaves.
options.viewport: A stepped tab rail down the edge.
options.case: Beautiful but heavy for a tool used every day.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.viewport: A giant figure with tiny labels.
options.kept: Large figures, small labels, few sizes between.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean light analytics app, executed carefully.
canonCard.viewport: Top bar, light cards, an indigo primary button.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other analytics tools by design.
